source_review.notes: Checked current ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148:2018 and 15288:2023 metadata; NASA Crosscutting Technical Management, Technical Requirements Definition, and Software Engineering Handbook bidirectional-traceability guidance; SEBoK 2.14 System Requirements Definition; INCOSE traceability webinar metadata; and the Gotel/Finkelstein DOI. NASA and SEBoK returned HTTP 200, and the DOI resolver returned HTTP 202. ISO and INCOSE returned HTTP 403 to the command-line client; current official metadata/content was independently inspected during authoring, but command-line reachability is not claimed.
